harness_surface.guardrails: CLAUDE.md (What this agent does not do) + .claude/settings.json deny
harness_surface.skills: skills/<id>@v<n>/ (SKILL.md, skill.json, scripts/, cases.json), run through src/run_skill.py
harness_surface.session_skills: .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md: run-skill, the one that names the runner, with library/index.md and one page per library skill beside it, rendered from the manifests; classify-knowledge; choose-session-level

note: A build copies this tree, fills CLAUDE.md's placeholders, adds tools/<name>/ with adapter.py, tool.json and errors/, fills CAPABILITIES.json and envelope/, writes validation/ and replay/ tasks, copies the skills the specification names into skills/ unchanged, renders .claude/skills/run-skill/library/ from their manifests (index.md and one page per skill) and writes .claude/agents/<name>.md for the subagents it names. The diff from this tree is recorded next to the bundle. v2 added src/run_skill.py and the Subagents section to v1 (meta_agent/tasks/010). v3 adds three session skills (meta_agent/tasks/015; the person, 2026-11-12): run-skill, which sends the bundle's session to src/run_skill.py and says what a session may and may not change, with its library pages; classify-knowledge and choose-session-level, adapted to a bundle from the Meta-Agent's own, naming no path outside the bundle and no script under src/; and in CLAUDE.md the sentences that name them and the rules they repeat. Bundle check B15 judges a bundle of v3 or later. v4 changes text only, after a fresh session was watched in a bundle of v3 (meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261112-meta-macbook-20261112-1-5.json): run-skill also says how a tool that no library skill calls is called, through src/run_tool.py, and its description and CLAUDE.md's sentence for it say so; tasks/001-start.md says that src/validate_tasks.py ends with a failure status when the verdict is undecided and that this is expected; a build with no library skill writes 'no library skill' where it wrote 'no skills'. v3 stays under templates/. v1 and v2 stay under templates/.
